hero.description: Backend-focused software developer working with C#/.NET and Python to build APIs, automation and applications that turn AI capabilities into practical software products.

services.title: Backend systems, automation and AI-enabled applications
services.description: I work across three connected areas: building the backend, connecting automation and AI capabilities, and delivering the supporting application layers needed for a usable product.

items.title: Backend & API Development
items.description: I build backend services, REST APIs and application logic with C# and ASP.NET Core, including authentication, authorization, data access and business rules.

items.title: Automation & AI Applications
items.description: I use Python for automation, service integration and connecting AI capabilities to practical application workflows, from local models to AI APIs.

items.title: Application Delivery
items.description: When a project needs a complete product, I also work across the frontend, data and deployment layers required to turn backend services into a usable application.

services.about: Backend is where I bring the strongest technical depth, while still thinking about how the complete application works around it.

featuredProjects.title: Projects that show how I build and deliver software
featuredProjects.description: Selected work covering backend APIs, application orchestration, automation and complete software delivery.

process.title: From problem to working software
process.description: I start with the problem and application responsibilities, then design and connect the services, data, automation and supporting layers needed for a working result.

items.title: Understand
items.description: Clarify the problem, users, business goals and technical requirements before choosing an implementation.

items.title: Design
items.description: Define backend responsibilities, APIs, data flow, permissions, integrations and the overall application structure.

items.title: Build
items.description: Implement the core services and workflows, then connect the required data, UI, automation and external integrations.

items.title: Deliver
items.description: Configure the runtime or production environment and verify that the complete application workflow works in practice.

technicalNotes.title: Notes from building and operating software
technicalNotes.description: Practical notes on backend APIs, automation, deployment, integration and the lessons that come from building AI-enabled applications.
